Recording notes
  • Keep this tab visible until the recording finishes. The renderer rests when the tab is hidden.
  • Each recording restarts the performance. The encounter approaches, explores the lens, then reacts, sprays black ASCII ink, and escapes.
  • The four-direction performance changes from horizontal to vertical, diagonal, then random paths every three seconds.
  • To make a GIF, run scripts/make-gifs.sh input.webm output.gif from the repository.
  • Recording requires a browser with Canvas captureStream and MediaRecorder support. The artwork itself needs only Canvas 2D.
Original procedural geometry. Recorded in your browser. No upload or recording service.
